headline: Actor Farhan Ahmed Jovan and wife injured in Cox's Bazar bike accident
summary: The actor and his wife were injured after a CNG suddenly made a U-turn in front of their scooty on Marine Drive. Jovan has since cancelled his shoots to recover.
details: Actor Farhan Ahmed Jovan and his wife, Sajin Ahmed Nirjona, were seriously injured in a motorcycle accident on Marine Drive in Cox's Bazar.
The incident occurred on June 11 while Jovan was riding a scooty with his wife as a passenger near Himchari.
According to Jovan, a CNG suddenly made a U-turn without signaling, forcing him to brake abruptly, which caused both of them to fall onto the road.
Both suffered injuries to their hands and legs and are currently receiving medical treatment at a hospital in Dhaka.
Due to the injuries, Jovan has cancelled all his scheduled shoots and is following doctor's orders to take complete rest.
Reflecting on the accident, Jovan urged everyone to follow traffic laws and wear helmets, emphasizing that arriving safely is more important than arriving quickly.
caption:
A sudden U-turn on Marine Drive left actor Farhan Ahmed Jovan and his wife injured. Now, he has a vital warning for all bikers.

Actor Farhan Ahmed Jovan and his wife, Sajin Ahmed Nirjona, were seriously injured in a motorcycle accident on Marine Drive in Cox's Bazar.

The incident occurred on June 11 while Jovan was riding a scooty with his wife as a passenger near Himchari.

According to Jovan, a CNG suddenly made a U-turn without signaling, forcing him to brake abruptly, which caused both of them to fall onto the road.

Both suffered injuries to their hands and legs and are currently receiving medical treatment at a hospital in Dhaka.

Due to the injuries, Jovan has cancelled all his scheduled shoots and is following doctor's orders to take complete rest.

Reflecting on the accident, Jovan urged everyone to follow traffic laws and wear helmets, emphasizing that arriving safely is more important than arriving quickly.

headline: Artist Mustafa Monwar in ICU after oxygen and blood pressure drop
summary: The 91-year-old national award-winning artist and puppeteer was rushed to a private hospital in Dhaka on June 14.
details: National award-winning artist and puppeteer Mustafa Monwar is currently undergoing treatment in the intensive care unit (ICU) of a private hospital in Dhaka.
He was rushed to the hospital on June 14 after his oxygen levels and blood pressure suddenly dropped, according to his wife, Merry Monowar.
The 91-year-old artist has been battling multiple physical complications and age-related ailments for several years.
Monwar had been hospitalized several times in recent months, including an admission on May 20, but was discharged on June 5 without a full recovery.
A recipient of the 2024 Ekhushey Padak, Monwar is a legendary figure in Bangladesh's art and puppetry scene.
Throughout his illustrious career, he served as director general of the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy and the National Institute of Mass Communication.
He also held key roles as the managing director of the Bangladesh Film Development Corporation and chairman of the Bangladesh Shishu Academy.
caption:
Legendary artist Mustafa Monwar is in the ICU after a sudden drop in oxygen and blood pressure.

National award-winning artist and puppeteer Mustafa Monwar is currently undergoing treatment in the intensive care unit (ICU) of a private hospital in Dhaka.

He was rushed to the hospital on June 14 after his oxygen levels and blood pressure suddenly dropped, according to his wife, Merry Monowar.

The 91-year-old artist has been battling multiple physical complications and age-related ailments for several years.

Monwar had been hospitalized several times in recent months, including an admission on May 20, but was discharged on June 5 without a full recovery.

A recipient of the 2024 Ekhushey Padak, Monwar is a legendary figure in Bangladesh's art and puppetry scene.

Throughout his illustrious career, he served as director general of the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy and the National Institute of Mass Communication.

He also held key roles as the managing director of the Bangladesh Film Development Corporation and chairman of the Bangladesh Shishu Academy.

Source: bdnews24.com, The Daily Star
